reproduction.rationale: Selected original endpoint: Complete Figure 4a–c sentence-onset versus no-speech decoding from the original Brain Treebank cohort and recorded movies: source linear contact/time outputs, eligible-contact peak map, source example curve and training-selected temporal/frontal held-out curves. Preserve the original ten-participant population, remove the source 114 corrupted contacts, retain subject 5 in nonregional analyses while excluding that subject from atlas-region analyses and brain plots. Preserve source single-electrode inputs, balanced examples and speech-free buffers, original shared splits, training-fitted preprocessing and five-fold training-CV contact selection. Exact window endpoints and identities remain subject to source verification, not a presumed count. Matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code delivery requires authentic source data/code manifests, operator-held final labels/reference, exact evaluator/runtime identity, source-specific access/resource budgets and exposure review. Recover source ROC-AUC arrays or an independently reproduced exact author baseline for the full original panel. See access-conditions.v1.json; no hashes or results are invented.
